literal_meaning: ঘরের বাটি বা ঢেঁকুর মতো শক্ত বস্তু
figurative_meaning_en: A strong but idle or lazy young man of the family
similar_in_english: Strong as an ox but lazy
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে ঘরের ঢেঁকি, শরীরে বল আছে কিন্তু কোনো কাজ করে না।
গ্রামের ছেলেরা বলে, ও ঘরের ঢেঁকি, শুধু খেয়ে বেড়ায়।
example_sentences_in_english: He is the family's pestle, full of strength but does no work.
The villagers say he is the house's pestle, just eating and idling around.
note: Refers to the traditional wooden pestle (ঢেঁকি) used in rural Bengali households for pounding rice, symbolizing something sturdy yet unproductive.
